Cold One
Dark Pegasus
They are no longer true horses, for dark magic has corrupted these finest of elven steeds, transforming them into black-flanked killers.
Beasts born and bred in Naggaroth, dark and vicious. They emerge from their warm, damp lairs to carry the Druchii into battle.
Corrupted pegasi flew south from the Chaos Wastes to the Iron Mountains of Naggaroth, where they made their nests.

Sorceress (Lore of Life)
Ghrond holds swirling vortices of the Eight Winds of Magic, and contrary to common understanding, some sorceresses have an uncanny affinity for the Wind of Ghyran, making them exceedingly rare.
Sorceress (Lore of Light)
Though all sorceresses can wield dark magic, a small few choose the white Wind of Hysh, more often to combat and banish the daemons of the north.
Sorceress (Lore of Heavens)
Astrology may be a common practice among the lowly Asur, but to freely command the Winds of Aethyr would surely confound and outmaneuver those 'masters' of the White Tower.
Sorceress (Lore of Metal)
These sorceresses excel at drawing the power of Chamon from the restless winds of magic, using this viscous mana to shape metal, forging it into deadly weapons.

Though all sorceresses possess the ability to wield dark magic, a small number of mages have chosen the White Wind of Hysh, more often to resist and banish the daemons of the North.

These sorceresses excel at drawing the power of Chamon from the restless winds of magic, using this viscous magical energy to shape metal into deadly weapons.
